error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the bed. It accepts one connection at a time - is the vendor app or another controller connected?
error.not_in_range: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy hears the bed right now.
error.no_free_slot: Every adapter that hears the bed is out of connection slots.
error.no_features: The bed did not say which motors it has.
error.pin_required: The bed has a PIN set. Enter it.

abort.already_configured: This bed is already set up.
abort.not_supported: This device does not speak the Octo protocol.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The bed has been read again.

data.position_steps: Steps to flat or a stored position

data_description.step_interval: Milliseconds between two steps. The bed only moves while steps keep arriving; the vendor app sends one every 300 to 350 ms.
data_description.move_steps: How many steps one open or close runs before the bed stops by itself. Steps times interval is the longest a movement lasts.
data_description.position_steps: The same for Flat and the stored positions, which need long enough to arrive.
data_description.idle_timeout: Seconds without a command before the connection is closed. It frees the proxy's connection slot for other devices.
data_description.keepalive_interval: Seconds between two PINs while connected. A locked bed drops the link after about 30 seconds without one.

no_scanner.message: No connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy is set up.

not_in_range.message: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy hears {address} right now.
